gloss: to come out; to appear; to emerge

definitions.gloss: to come out; to emerge (toward the speaker or from within)
definitions.explanation: To come out of an enclosed space, to emerge from somewhere, or to appear on the scene. Combines 出る (to exit) with くる (to come), indicating movement toward the speaker or present location.

definitions.gloss: to appear; to come up (in conversation, text, or data)
definitions.explanation: To appear or turn up in a non-physical sense — such as a word appearing in a book, a name coming up in conversation, or a problem emerging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{押入|おしい}れ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: The cat came out of the closet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{誰|だれ}か→誰か：02912_dareka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出|で}てくる⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧がした。
examples.english: I heard someone coming out from the front door.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出|で}てきたら、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When new vocabulary appears in the textbook, I look it up right away.
His name came up in the conversation.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ + くる. The くる component indicates the movement is directed toward the present location or the speaker.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{出|で}てくる: to come out from ~
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出|で}てくる: to come up in conversation
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{出|で}てくる: a problem emerges

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧いく: to go out (away from speaker)
- ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to exit (neutral direction)
